summary: Large private group from Edwards with several boats and kayaks; one boat high-centered on an already-pinned abandoned raft in Boneyard Rapid between Yarmony and Rancho Del Rio; occupants swam out, one woman in her early 30s became trapped; recovered by about 5 p.m., unresponsive to CPR.
location: Boneyard Rapid, Upper Colorado River, between Yarmony and Rancho Del Rio
notes: County filed Grand per the Yarmony Rapid precedent (id 3417); Boneyard Rapid sits in the Radium-Rancho del Rio stretch near the Eagle/Grand line - ECSO release notes first responders from both Eagle and Grand counties.
